sources: IMF World Economic Outlook (2025), GDP per capita, PPP (current international $), 2025 estimates – world ≈ 25,600; USA ≈ 86,000; Germany ≈ 74,000; China ≈ 27,000; Mexico ≈ 26,000; Thailand ≈ 25,000; India ≈ 11,000; Nigeria ≈ 9,000 (rounded; editions differ by a few %). GDP per person is used as 'income per person' (standard proxy, e.g. Our World in Data); it is not take-home pay. 'Live like an average person in Mexico or Thailand' = same average output per person, ignoring distribution within countries.
